observations: body L1: «للقَطَافِ» has a fatḥa over the qāf (the form qaṭāf), not a kasra under it; «المُتَقَدِّمُ» has the shadda over the dāl and the kasra under it.
body L2: «الأَسَد» has no vowel sign on its final dāl.
body L3: the breathing of «Ἀντάρης» is printed before the capital; it is the smooth one.
body L5: «ζώδια» is printed without the iota subscript; transcribed as printed. «اِنْقِلاب» has no vowel sign on the lām.
body L9: «’l–‘Alā’» is printed with an en dash (5.4 points). «القَمَرَان» has no vowel sign on its final nūn. A speck over the L of «lxxv» is not transcribed.
body L11: the dash after «قنطورس.» is 7.7 points long, shorter than the other em dashes of the page (9.4-10.7 points); transcribed —.
body L18: the middle figure of «١٧{1, 3, 4}» is a 3 whose upper terminal touches the middle stroke (a closed counter of 1.3 square points), the sort of the 3 after ٣٧ on p. 348 (L11).
body L19: «نِصْف», «قَوْس» (twice) and «النهار» have no vowel sign on their last letters; the damma of «النُّور» lies flat over the shadda.
body L23: the semicolon after «١٣٠{18}» has its point printed broken, in two small fragments over the comma.
body L24: a speck at mid-height after «ascendens» is not transcribed.
body L27, L28: «διόρϑωσις» and «διορϑώσεως» are printed with the theta ϑ.
body L31: «حقّيّ» has a shadda over the qāf and another over the final yāʾ.
body L36, L38: «مُسْتَوِيَة» (L36) has no vowel sign on the tāʾ marbūṭa; «فِي» has the kasra in L36, «في» none in L38.

body L1-L3, L11, L32, L35, L36: the article ὁ is the δ-shaped sort with the head turned to the right (the rough breathing); «ὑπολει-» (L32) has the rough breathing, «ἐνέργεια» (L35) and «ἰσοδυναμοῦντα» (L36) the smooth one.
